## Installation

### From Source
```bash
git clone https://github.com/j-alexander3375/Lotus
cd Lotus
git checkout v{VERSION}
cd src
go build -o ../lotus .
```

### Arch Linux (AUR)
```bash
yay -S lotus-lang
# or
paru -S lotus-lang
```

### Binary Downloads
Download pre-built binaries from the [releases page](https://github.com/j-alexander3375/Lotus/releases/tag/v{VERSION}).

## Checksums

SHA256 checksums for release artifacts are available in the release assets.
